info.title: AgentsPodium account API (agent-facing subset)
info.description: Create, configure, pay for and watch AI agent pods, meant to be driven directly by an agent. This document covers the subset an agent (rather than a human operator) needs: auth, agent lifecycle, tools/models/personas catalog, payment, A2A directory. See https://hosting.defispace.com/docs/quickstart.md for a narrative walkthrough.

post.summary: Request a six-digit sign-in code by e-mail.
post.description: Send this first when authenticating with an e-mail address instead of an API key. Always answers 202, whether or not the address has an account — never poll this for existence. The code is valid 10 minutes; feed it to POST /auth/verify.

202.description: Accepted — a code was sent (or the address does not exist; the response looks the same either way).

devCode.description: Only present when the server runs with devShowCode (local/dev).

400.description: Bad request — the body failed validation.

post.summary: Exchange an e-mail code for a bearer token.
post.description: Call this right after POST /auth/request with the six-digit code the address received. The returned token works as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every authenticated call below; it lives 30 days. For an agent that cannot read the mailbox itself, mint an API key from the account page instead (see bearerAuth).

attribution.description: Optional marketing attribution; safe to omit.

400.description: Bad request — the body failed validation.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential.

get.summary: List this account's API keys.
get.description: Use to check what keys already exist before minting another; secrets are never included, only id/name/prefix/timestamps. Requires a session token — a key cannot list keys on its own behalf is untrue, but it also cannot mint or revoke one (see POST/DELETE below).

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential.

post.summary: Mint a new API key for this account.
post.description: Call once from a signed-in session to create the credential an agent will use going forward (`Authorization: Bearer ak_live_…`). The secret is returned exactly once, in this response, under `secret` — store it immediately, it cannot be retrieved again. Refused (403) when called with an API key rather than a session token, so a leaked key cannot mint its own replacements.

secret.description: The only time the full secret is ever returned.

400.description: Bad request — the body failed validation.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential does not carry this right (e.g. an API key managing keys).

delete.description: Call when a key has leaked or is no longer needed. The key stops working immediately (401 "Invalid or revoked API key" on next use); it is not deleted from history. Requires a session token, not the key being revoked or any other key.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential does not carry this right (e.g. an API key managing keys).

404.description: No such agent, key, or persona for this account.

get.summary: List the public persona catalog.
get.description: Call before creating an agent to choose a `personaId` — built-in personas plus any published community ones. No auth required; browse freely.

get.summary: Read one persona's full catalog entry.
get.description: Call to inspect a persona's soul, localizations and example demo before deploying it, or to render its detail page. No auth required.

articles.description: Articles written about this persona (bodies omitted).

404.description: No such persona.

get.summary: List the pricing plans and the trial length.
get.description: Call to show or validate plan choices before POST /agents — this is the one source of truth for prices and specs, do not hard-code them. No auth required.

get.summary: List the platforms (engines) that can be deployed.
get.description: Call before POST /agents to pick a valid `engine` and confirm the tier you want meets its `minTier`. No auth required.

podHostSuffix.description: Host suffix agent dashboards are proxied from; null when that proxy is off.

get.summary: List Hermes toolsets available to enable on an agent.
get.description: Call to build the `tools.enabled` list for POST /agents or PATCH /agents/{id}/tools.

minimalToolsets.description: Ids enabled by default when a persona is deployed with nothing chosen.

get.summary: List the curated LLM model catalog.
get.description: Call to pick a valid `model` id for PATCH /agents/{id}/llm-key or POST /agents.

get.summary: List LLM providers Hermes can take a key for.
get.description: Call to validate the `provider` value before PATCH /agents/{id}/llm-key.

get.summary: Check whether the platform itself is healthy.
get.description: Call when a request is behaving oddly, to tell "the API is degraded" apart from "my agent/pod is broken" — see also GET /healthz for just the API process.

get.summary: List every agent (pod) owned by this account.
get.description: Call to enumerate your fleet, e.g. to find an id before acting on it.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential.

post.summary: Create a new agent (deploy a pod).
post.description: Call once to provision a pod. The call is synchronous and returns once the pod exists, typically within one to two minutes — the engine inside may need a few more seconds, which GET /agents/{id}/liveness tells you. Follow with PATCH /agents/{id}/llm-key: a fresh pod has no model key and answers nothing until one is set.

tier.description: Must satisfy the chosen engine's minTier.

name.description: Up to 60 chars; the pod's hostnames are derived from it.

extraSoul.description: Owner instructions appended to the persona's SOUL.

domain.description: Your own hostname, e.g. agent.example.com. Names under agentspodium.com are assigned automatically and refused here.

webhookUrl.description: Public http(s) URL to POST pod events to. The signing secret comes back once as `webhookSecret` beside `agent`.

app.description: Required when engine is "app". Add repoToken (string) for a private repository; it is stored encrypted and never returned.

200.description: Created — the pod exists and status is "running" (the engine inside may still be booting).

webhookSecret.description: Only when `webhookUrl` was given: the HMAC secret for verifying deliveries. Shown once.

delete.description: Call only when you are certain: this destroys the pod after a final backup and wipes every secret and every line the owner wrote. Export first (GET /agents/{id}/export) if the data might still be needed.

post.description: Call to move the pod to a different tier; it rebuilds with data migrated. Poll GET /agents/{id} until status is "running" afterward.

patch.description: Call right after creating an agent — without a key it accepts messages and answers nothing. Send `key: null` to clear it. This rebuilds the pod (about a minute); poll liveness again afterward.

key.description: The provider's API key; null clears it.

provider.description: Required together with a non-null key; a key for one vendor and a model from another is a dead pod.

Create the order before sending anything: the address is shared per account and the order records the balance at that moment as its baseline — a transfer sent earlier pays for nothing. Status: beta testing — verified through card payments, the crypto path itself is still being tested.

put.summary: Set the URL that receives signed events about this agent's pod.
put.description: Call once instead of polling: agent.running, agent.stopped, agent.failed, agent.deleted, payment.confirmed, deletion.warning are POSTed there with an HMAC signature. Replacing the URL issues a new secret; the secret is returned only by this call. Private and loopback hosts are refused.

bearerAuth.description: An API key `ak_live_…` created on the account page, or a session token from /auth/verify.

ApiError.description: Uniform error body sent by the global error handler for every 4xx/5xx response.

error.description: Stable machine code, e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, RATE_LIMITED, INVALID_CODE, INTERNAL.

message.description: Human-readable reason, safe to show to whoever is driving the agent.

AgentQuota.description: Latest RAM/disk snapshot for a pod, refreshed about once a minute from the cluster.

memoryPct.description: memoryUsedBytes / memoryLimitBytes, or null when either side is unknown.

status.description: paused means the pod was auto-stopped for exceeding its plan.

AgentTools.description: Enabled Hermes toolsets and user-defined MCP servers.

enabled.description: Toolset ids from GET /tools; empty means the safe minimal set.

name.description: Unique server name; used as the server:tool prefix in Hermes.

A2aPeerPublic.description: Another A2A agent this one may call by name. The peer's bearer token is write-only and never serialized back.

Agent.description: One pod. Serialized with the engine encryption key and the plaintext-adjacent LLM key ciphertext stripped; every other stored field is returned as is.

createdAt.description: The free trial is counted from here.

dseq.description: Akash deployment sequence (the pod's namespace), set after a successful deploy.

llmKeyHash.description: sha256 of the configured LLM key; set once a key is installed.

dashUsername.description: Login for the engine's own dashboard, when the engine has one.

domain.description: The customer's own hostname if set, otherwise null (the pod still answers at <a2aSlug>.agentspodium.com).

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Null means the pod's UTC default.

a2aToken.description: Bearer peers must send to this agent's A2A endpoint. Null when the a2a toolset is off.

extraSoul.description: The owner's own additions appended to the persona's SOUL.

a2aSlug.description: Stable label every one of this agent's hostnames is built from.

trialNoticeDay.description: Which trial reminder has already gone out: 3, 2, 1, or 0 for paused.

telegramTokenEnc.description: "set" when a Telegram bot token is stored for this agent, otherwise null. The token itself never leaves the server.

a2aListed.description: Whether the owner opted into the public A2A catalog (GET /a2a-catalog).

webhookUrl.description: Receiver for pod events, or null. Set with PUT /agents/{id}/webhook or `webhookUrl` on create.

webhookLastStatus.description: Outcome of the latest delivery: the HTTP status (`200`) or `error: …`.

webhookLastEvent.description: Type of the latest delivered event.

appRepoTokenEnc.description: "set" when a private-repository token is stored; the token itself never leaves the server.

skillRegistry.description: Whether the engine can search a skill registry itself.

llmProviders.description: Providers this engine accepts; omitted means every provider AgentsPodium offers.

annualUsd.description: Annual price; two months free versus paying monthly.

Persona.description: Public catalog entry: a built-in persona, or a community persona once published.

doesExamples.description: One example question per `does` label, keyed by that label.

tier.description: Recommended minimum plan for this persona.

demo.description: Scripted, illustrative conversation. Absent when none was written.

Subscription.description: A paid term for one agent. Returned verbatim by GET /subscriptions, including the raw license key used to activate it.

currentPeriodEnd.description: "Paid till" — when this term ends absent a renewal.

provider.description: Payment provider id, e.g. gumroad, usdt, usdc, telegram-stars, internal.

licenseKey.description: Raw provider license key, kept so a re-verify can happen later.

anyOf.description: The tier's definition frozen at order time, so a later price change never rewrites what this order meant.

expiredAt.description: When payment stopped verifying; the grace period is counted from here, not from signup.

ApiKey.description: A machine credential. The secret itself (ak_live_…) is shown once, at creation, and never again.

prefix.description: First 12 characters of the secret, kept to recognize it in the list.

AgentTerm.description: The one answer to when this agent's current term ends.

stopsAt.description: When a free agent's pod is paused (trial/grace only).

deletesAt.description: When a free agent is deleted for good (trial/grace only).

paidTill.description: End of the current paid period (paid only).

renewUrl.description: Where a human pays to renew this agent.

expectedIp.description: The address the customer's A record has to carry.

status.description: skipped when DNS does not point here yet, or when the caller did not ask for the HTTPS probe.

reachable.description: The cluster says the pod exists and is ready. Null when there is no address yet.

serving.description: An HTTP request to the pod's address returned something below 5xx. Null when the connection itself failed.

AgentMemory.description: Read-only view of a Hermes agent's persona data.

buyUrls.description: Per-tier purchase page, keyed by tier id.

amount.description: Amount owed, in the token's smallest unit (string to avoid float loss).

baseline.description: The deposit address's balance at order creation; payment is (balance - baseline) >= amount.

starUsd.description: USD value of one Telegram Star, used to price orders.

id.description: Passed back as `model` on create / PATCH llm-key.

plugin.description: Set for entries that are Hermes plugins rather than built-in toolsets.

WebhookEvent.description: The JSON body POSTed to your webhook URL. Verify `X-AgentsPodium-Signature` (`sha256=` + hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with your secret) before trusting it.

id.description: Delivery id; also sent as `X-AgentsPodium-Delivery`. Retries reuse it, so it is your idempotency key.

data.description: Per type: status changes carry `from`/`to`; `payment.confirmed` carries `provider`, `tier`, `period`, `paidTill`; `deletion.warning` carries `daysLeft` (null once paused) and `keptDays`.

status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt, or null when the receiver was unreachable.

AppConfig.description: Build and run configuration for engine "app": a customer repository served as frontend plus backend on one pod.

repo.description: Public https git URL. Private repositories need repoToken on create.

runtime.description: Omit and the pod detects it from the repository.

outputDir.description: Static output, relative to rootDir; null means no static half.

startCommand.description: Backend process; null means a static-only app.

appPort.description: Port the backend listens on inside the pod.

apiPrefix.description: Paths routed to the backend; everything else is served from outputDir.

env.description: Environment variables for the app. Not for secrets.

rootDir.description: Directory inside the repository where the build runs. For a monorepo whose app is not at the root. Netlify calls this "base".

repoUser.description: Username paired with repoToken when the host wants one. Left out, we use what the host expects: x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the token alone for Gitea and Forgejo.

logTail.description: Last lines of the build log.
